purpose: Teach: デュアル/ダイアログ/コンパイル/アンカー/グリッド/シールド/レビューア/コストパフォーマンス
target_vocab: コストパフォーマンス

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: デュアルモニターを営業部全員に支給しましょう
lines.en: Let's equip the entire sales department with dual monitors.
lines.style: Crisp, decisive opening. Measured pace. Speaks from position of quiet authority. No hesitation—this is decided.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内チャットのダイアログ履歴を保管します
lines.en: Got it. I'll archive the internal chat dialogue history.
lines.style: Quick acknowledgment with light efficiency. Businesslike but warm. The tone of someone taking notes and moving forward.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: プログラムのコンパイル待ち時間を計測しましょう
lines.en: Let's measure the compile wait times for our programs.
lines.style: Clear directive. Steady tempo. Practical—she's thinking ahead. No inflection of doubt, just forward momentum.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。式典のアンカー、つまり司会者を内部から選びます
lines.en: Understood. We'll select the ceremony host—the MC—from within the team.
lines.style: Affirmative and matter-of-fact. Brief pause after the slash—clarifying without patronizing. Moves on briskly.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 資料のレイアウトをグリッド準拠にしましょう
lines.en: Let's make the material layouts grid-compliant.
lines.style: Instruction delivered with quiet confidence. Slight stress on the requirement. Even pacing, no elaboration needed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新工場のシールド工事の見積りを取ります
lines.en: Understood. I'll get quotes for the shielding work at the new facility.
lines.style: Calm confirmation. Writing-it-down rhythm. Competent, no flourish. Simply executing the next task.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: レビューア、つまり評価者の枠を増やしましょう
lines.en: Let's expand the reviewer pool—the number of evaluators available.
lines.style: Composed directive. Slight explanatory pause at the dash. Professional tone, not rushed. Speaks clearly to ensure clarity.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。コストパフォーマンスを店頭でも訴求します
lines.en: Got it. We'll emphasize cost-effectiveness at point of sale as well.
lines.style: Final confirmation. Warm close to the sequence. Slight breath of completion at the end. Collaborative rather than obedient.
